scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && dotnet build backend/SmallestAgent.Gateway.csproj --no-restore
scripts.test: node scripts/python.mjs -m pytest -q && npm --prefix frontend test && dotnet run --project backend.tests/Gateway.IntegrationTests.csproj
scripts.build: npm run generate:lesson && npm --prefix frontend run build && dotnet publish backend/SmallestAgent.Gateway.csproj -c Release -o backend/artifacts/publish
